guide:
Wander 2 — Skywalker's behavior language (ECPS: Entity · Component · Prompt System)

A behavior = an `intent` (plain language, the human source of truth) + deterministic code.
Safe by construction: every handler run has a step budget (loops can't hang the engine),
randomness is seeded (runs replay exactly), and the compiler reports line/column/code/hint.

behavior Guard
  intent "Patrol between two posts; chase the player when close; lose 1 hp per hit."
  param speed = 3 in 0..10 "walk speed (m/s)"   -- tunable: shown as a slider in the editor
  var hp = 3                                    -- per-entity state (persisted, visible to tools)
  var posts: list = []

  on start
    posts = [self.position, self.position + (6, 0, 0)]
  end

  state Patrol                                  -- first state is the initial one
    on tick
      let goal = posts[floor(state_time / 4) % 2]
      move self toward goal at speed
      let p = nearest("player", 5)
      if p then go to Chase end
    end
  end

  state Chase
    on enter
      self.color = #ff4040
    end
    on tick
      let p = nearest("player", 8)
      if not p then go to Patrol end
      move self toward p at speed * 1.5
    end
  end

  on event "damage" with hit                     -- payload map; `other` is the sender
    hp -= hit.get("amount", 1)
    if hp <= 0 then
      emit "guard_down" with {at: self.position}
      destroy self
    end
  end

  on event "alarm"
    wait 0.5                                     -- coroutine: resumes 0.5 s later (per entity)
    log "{self.name} heard the alarm"
  end

  test "loses hp when hit"
    emit "damage" with {amount: 1} to self
    wait frames 2
    expect hp == 2
  end
end

TRIGGERS  on start | on tick | on event "name" (with x) | on key "space" | on click
          inside a state: on enter | on exit | on tick | on event ...  (plus subsystem triggers, see below)
DECLARE   var x = 0 (per entity; `x` or `self.x`)  |  param x = 1 in 0..5 "doc"  |  const MAX = 10
          fn name(a, b: number) -> number ... return a + b end   (recursion ok)  |  use "scripts/combat" (then combat.fn())
STATEMENTS
  let x = v | x = v | x += v (-= *= /=) | set x to v
  if c then .. elif c then .. else .. end     (`then` optional)
  for x in list .. end | for i, x in list | for k, v in map | for i in 0..10 (end excluded; 0..=10 includes) step 2
  while c .. end | repeat n times .. end | break | continue | return v | stop
  every 2 seconds .. end | after 1 seconds .. end      (timers that tick with the handler)
  wait 1.5 | wait frames 3 | wait until hp <= 0         (handlers and tests only, not inside fn)
  go to StateName
  move e by vec | move e toward point at speed | rotate e by (0, 90 * dt, 0) | look e at point
  emit "event" (with payload) (to entity) | destroy e | log value
VALUES    1.5  "text {interpolated}"  true false none  #ff8800  (x, y, z)  [list]  {key: value}
OPERATORS + - * / %   < <= > >= == !=   and or not   x in list/map/string   "a" + 1 joins text
NAMES     self  other (sender / collision partner)  dt  time  frame  pi  state  state_time  data (event payload)
PROPERTIES e.position e.rotation (degrees) e.scale e.color e.name e.id e.enabled e.tags e.parent e.state
          e.<component>.<field> (self.light.intensity, self.particles.rate)   e.<var>
          v.x v.y v.z v.length   c.r c.g c.b c.a   list.length   string.length   map.key
LISTS/MAPS are values (copied on assignment); mutate in place with methods: self.items.push(x)
TESTS     test "name" .. end — run by wander_test in a sandbox: expect cond ("why"), wait (advances the sim),
          emit, press "space" / hold "w" / release "w" / click e, spawn(...). Tests start after the first tick.

IDIOMS
  - Smooth motion: move self toward target at speed  |  self.position = lerp(self.position, goal, 1 - exp(-8 * dt))
  - Frame-rate independent: always multiply per-tick changes by dt.
  - Sequences: on event "open" .. wait 1 .. end — no manual timers.
  - Find things: nearest("enemy", 10), find_all("coin"), find("Door"); check `if x then` before using a maybe-none.
  - Cooldowns: var cooldown = 0 / cooldown -= dt / if cooldown <= 0 then ... cooldown = 1 end
  - Share code across behaviors with modules: use "scripts/util" then util.clamp01(x).
  - Prefer states over boolean flags for modes (Idle/Chase/Flee); `state` reads the current one.
RULES     meters, +Y up, entities face -Z, rotations are Euler degrees (pitch X, yaw Y, roll Z).
          A handler that errors 5 times disables its script. Events arrive next tick, in emission order.

FUNCTIONS (category: signature — what it does)
  [2d]
    play_anim(entity: entity, clip: string, restart: bool?) — Plays a sprite_anim clip (keeps playing if it already is, unless restart). Frame events arrive as `on anim "name"`; a non-looping clip sends `on anim "finished"`.
    set_tile(map: entity, position: vector|entity, tile: number|string, layer: string?) — Sets the tile at a world position: an id (0 clears) or a terrain from tilemap.autotile (auto-tiled).
    tile_at(map: entity, position: vector|entity, layer: string?) -> number — Tile id of a tilemap at a world position (topmost non-empty layer, or the named layer); 0 = empty.
  [animation]
    anim_state(entity: entity) -> string — Name of the animator's current state.
    foot_ik(entity: entity, on: bool, weight: number?) — Turns automatic foot planting on or off (feet on stairs, slopes and rocks, pelvis lowered, feet locked while planted); the optional weight fades it (0..1). Adds the characterIk component if needed.
    hand_ik(entity: entity, side: string, target: none|entity, weight: number?) — Makes a character's hand reach an entity ("left" or "right"): a grip point on a staff held in the other hand, a ledge, a rail, a door handle. `none` (or weight 0) releases it. Adds the characterIk component if needed.
    look_at(entity: entity, target: none|entity, weight: number?) — Turns a character's head and upper spine toward an entity (look-at IK, clamped by animator.lookAtLimit), or stops with `none`; the turn fades in and out smoothly.
    play_animation(entity: entity, clip: string, fade: number?, loop: bool?) — Crossfades straight to a clip or state (seconds of fade, default 0.2).
    play_sequence(entity: entity, start: number?) — Plays the entity's sequencer (a cutscene) from `start` seconds.
    set_param(entity: entity, name: string, value: bool|number) — Sets an animator controller parameter (blend spaces and transitions read them).
    trigger(entity: entity, name: string) — Fires an animator trigger (jump, attack, wave).
    turn_in_place(entity: entity, toward: number|vector|entity) — Turns a standing character in place toward a world yaw (degrees, 0 = -Z) or to face a point / entity, at characterIk.turnSpeed; planted feet stay locked and re-plant in small steps. Controllers can read the float `turn` (degrees left) and bool `turning` parameters to play turn clips.
  [audio]
    music(clip: string, fade: number?) — Crossfades the music to a clip ("" fades out); fade in seconds.
    play(e: entity) — Starts the entity's audio component (its clip, volume, spatial settings).
    play_sound(clip: string, volume: number?) — Plays a one-shot sound at self (positional), e.g. a hit or a pickup.
    set_volume(bus: string, volume: number) — Sets a mixer bus volume (master, music, sfx, ambience, voice, ui), 0..1.
    stop_sound(e: entity) — Stops the entity's audio component.
  [character]
    grounded(e: entity) -> bool — Whether a character stands on the ground.
    jump(e: entity, speed: number?) -> bool — Makes a grounded character jump (default: its jumpSpeed); false when airborne.
    walk(e: entity, direction: vector) — Moves a character this tick (|direction| 1 = its moveSpeed). Call every tick while walking.
  [color]
    color(r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number?) -> color — Makes a color from 0..1 channels.
    hsv(h: number, s: number, v: number) -> color — Color from hue (0..1, wraps), saturation and value.
  [dialogue]
    dialogue_advance() — Shows the rest of the typing line, or moves to the next line.
    dialogue_choose(index: number) — Picks one of the current dialogue choices (0-based).
    dialogue_var(name: string, value?) -> any — Reads (or with a value, sets) a dialogue variable ($trust = "trust") of the first dialogue component.
    start_dialogue(entity_or_node: entity|string, node: string?) — Starts a conversation at a node: start_dialogue("Intro") on the first dialogue component, or start_dialogue(entity, "Intro").
  [effects]
    burst(entity_or_count: number|entity, count: number?) — Emits particles right now from self's particles (or particles2d) component: burst(n), or burst(entity, n) for another emitter. Explosions, muzzle flashes, impacts, dust puffs.
    water_height(x_or_point: number|vector|entity, z: number?) -> number — Height of the animated water surface at (x, z) or at a point — the same surface that is rendered (0 where there is no water). Boats, buoyancy, splashes.
  [input]
    action(name: string) -> bool — Whether an input action is held ("jump", "fire" from input.json).
    axis(name: string) -> number|vector — Value of an axis action: a number (-1..1), or a vector (x, y, 0) for 2D axes (x right, y forward/up).
    cursor_lock(on: bool) — Hides and captures the mouse cursor (first-person look: read mouse movement with axis("look")) or gives it back. Honored by the standalone player; resets when the game stops.
    key(name: string) -> bool — Whether a key is held ("w", "space", "left", ...).
    key_pressed(name: string) -> bool — Whether a key was pressed this tick (once per press).
    pressed(name: string) -> bool — Whether an input action was pressed this tick.
    quit_game() — Closes the game (a "Quit" menu button). The standalone player exits; the editor ignores it.
    released(name: string) -> bool — Whether an input action was released this tick.
  [list]
    list|map.clear() — Removes everything.
    string|list|map.contains(item) -> bool — Lists: has an equal item. Maps: has the key. Strings: has the substring. (Same as `x in y`.)
    list.first() -> any — The first item (none if empty).
    string|list.index_of(item) -> number — Position of the first equal item/substring, or -1.
    list.insert(index: number, item) — Inserts an item before index (index = length appends).
    string|list|map.is_empty() -> bool — Whether it has no items / keys / characters.
    list.join(separator: string?) -> string — Text of all items joined by a separator.
    list.last() -> any — The last item (none if empty).
    list.pop() -> any — Removes and returns the last item.
    list.push(item) — Appends an item.
    list|map.remove(item_or_key) -> bool — Lists: removes the first item equal to the argument. Maps: removes a key. Returns whether something was removed.
    list.remove_at(index: number) -> any — Removes and returns the item at index.
    list.reverse() — Reverses the list in place.
    string|list.slice(from: number, to: number?) -> string|list — Items (or characters) from index `from` up to, not including, `to`. Negative indexes count from the end.
    list.sort() — Sorts numbers or strings in place (ascending).
    list.sorted() -> list — A sorted copy (numbers or strings).
    list.sum() -> number — Sum of a list of numbers.
  [map]
    map.get(key: string, default?) -> any — Value for a key, or the default (none) if missing.
    map.has(key: string) -> bool — Whether the map has a key.
    map.keys() -> list — The keys, in insertion order.
    map.set(key: string, value) — Sets a key (same as m[key] = value).
    map.values() -> list — The values, in insertion order.
  [math]
    abs(x: number) -> number — Absolute value.
    acos(x: number) -> number — Arc cosine in radians (x is clamped to -1..1).
    approach(current: number, target: number, max_step: number) -> number — Moves current toward target by at most max_step (never overshoots).
    asin(x: number) -> number — Arc sine in radians (x is clamped to -1..1).
    atan(x: number) -> number — Arc tangent in radians.
    atan2(y: number, x: number) -> number — Angle of the point (x, y) in radians, -pi..pi.
    ceil(x: number) -> number — Smallest whole number >= x.
    clamp(x: number, lo: number, hi: number) -> number — x limited to the range lo..hi.
    cos(radians: number) -> number — Cosine of an angle in radians.
    deg(radians: number) -> number — Radians to degrees.
    exp(x: number) -> number — e raised to x.
    floor(x: number) -> number — Largest whole number <= x.
    inverse_lerp(a: number, b: number, x: number) -> number — Where x lies between a (0) and b (1).
    lerp(a: number|vector|color, b: number|vector|color, t: number) -> number|vector|color — Linear blend from a (t=0) to b (t=1); numbers, vectors or colors.
    ln(x: number) -> number — Natural logarithm (x > 0).
    max(a: number|list, b: number?, ...) -> number — Larger of numbers, or the largest number in a list.
    min(a: number|list, b: number?, ...) -> number — Smaller of numbers, or the smallest number in a list.
    noise(x: number, y: number?) -> number — Smooth deterministic value noise in -1..1 (1D or 2D).
    pow(base: number, exponent: number) -> number — base raised to exponent.
    rad(degrees: number) -> number — Degrees to radians.
    round(x: number, digits: number?) -> number — Rounds to the nearest whole number, or to `digits` decimals.
    sign(x: number) -> number — -1, 0 or 1.
    sin(radians: number) -> number — Sine of an angle in radians.
    smoothstep(edge0: number, edge1: number, x: number) -> number — Smooth 0..1 ramp between two edges.
    sqrt(x: number) -> number — Square root (0 for negative input).
    tan(radians: number) -> number — Tangent of an angle in radians.
  [navigation]
    arrived(e: entity) -> bool — Whether a nav agent reached its destination.
    navigate(e: entity, target: vector|entity) — Walks a nav agent to a point, or follows an entity as it moves. `on event "arrived"` fires on arrival.
    path_length(from: vector|entity, to: vector|entity) -> none|number — Walking distance along the navmesh; none if unreachable or there is no navmesh.
    stop_navigation(e: entity) — Stops a nav agent.
  [physics]
    impulse(e: entity, impulse: vector) — An instant kick (N s) to a dynamic body.
    overlap_sphere(center: vector|entity, radius: number, tag: string?) -> none|entity — Nearest entity (not self) whose collider overlaps the sphere, optionally with a tag; none if empty.
    push(e: entity, force: vector) — Applies a continuous force (N) to a dynamic body this step.
    raycast(origin: vector|entity, direction: vector, max_distance: number?) -> none|entity — First collider hit along a ray (self is ignored); sets hit_point, hit_normal and hit_distance.
    torque(e: entity, torque: vector) — Applies a torque (N m) to a dynamic body.
    velocity(e: entity) -> vector — Current linear velocity of a body or character (m/s).
  [random]
    chance(p: number) -> bool — true with probability p (0..1).
    pick(items: list) -> any — A random element of a list (none if empty).
    random(lo_or_hi: number?, hi: number?) -> number — random() is 0..1; random(hi) is 0..hi; random(lo, hi) is lo..hi. Seeded by the scene: replays exactly.
    random_int(lo: number, hi: number) -> number — A whole number from lo to hi (both included).
    shuffle(items: list) -> list — A shuffled copy of a list.
  [render]
    layer_mask(layers: number|string|list, ...) -> number — Render layer bitmask from layer names (game.json render.layers), layer numbers as strings ("3"), "all" / "none", or a list of names / layer numbers; several arguments are combined. Set it on mesh.layers, camera.cullMask or light.cullMask, e.g. hide the player's own body from the first-person camera.
    probe_bake(probe: entity?) — Re-captures a reflection probe (or every probe without an argument) over the next rendered frames: after opening a door, switching the room's lights or rearranging furniture, so `once` probes reflect the new state. Rendering only; the simulation is unaffected.
  [scene]
    add_tag(e: entity, tag: string) — Adds a tag to an entity.
    children(e: entity) -> list — Direct children of an entity, in order.
    count(tag: string) -> number — How many entities have a tag.
    exists(e) -> bool — Whether a value is an entity that still exists.
    find(name: string) -> none|entity — Entity by name (or "#id"); none if missing. "%Name" finds the entity marked unique (entity_update unique=true) inside this prefab instance, else in the scene, so each copy of a prefab finds its own part.
    find_all(tag: string) -> list — Active entities with a tag, in scene order.
    has(e: entity, component: string) -> bool — Whether the entity has a component ("light", "particles", ...).
    nearest(tag: string, max_distance: number?) -> none|entity — Closest other active entity with a tag (within max_distance); none if there is none.
    remove_tag(e: entity, tag: string) — Removes a tag from an entity.
    set_parent(e: entity, parent: none|entity, keep_world: bool?) — Moves an entity under a new parent, or to the scene root with none. By default it keeps its world position, rotation and scale (keep_world = false keeps its local transform instead, so it jumps to the same offset from the new parent). Parenting under itself or a descendant fails. Like every play-time change, it is undone when play stops.
    spawn(mesh: string, position: vector|entity?, name?) -> entity — Creates an entity: a primitive mesh ("cube", "sphere"...), "asset:models/x.glb", or a whole prefab "prefab:prefabs/coin.prefab.json" (with its children and behaviors). Its behaviors start next tick. Limits: 256 spawns per tick, 20000 entities.
    tagged(e, tag: string) -> bool — Whether an entity has a tag (false for none).
  [text]
    num(text) -> none|number — Number parsed from text (none if it is not a number).
    str(value) -> string — Text form of any value (entities give their name).
    type_of(value) -> string — The type name: number, bool, string, vector, color, entity, list, map, none.
    string.ends_with(suffix: string) -> bool — Whether the text ends with a suffix.
    string.lower() -> string — Lowercase copy.
    string.replace(old: string, new: string) -> string — Copy with every occurrence of old replaced.
    string.split(separator: string?) -> list — Parts of the text between separators (default: spaces).
    string.starts_with(prefix: string) -> bool — Whether the text starts with a prefix.
    string.trim() -> string — Copy without leading/trailing spaces.
    string.upper() -> string — Uppercase copy.
  [time]
    is_paused() -> bool — True while the game is paused (or will be from the next tick, after pause_game()).
    pause_game(paused: bool?) — Pauses the game (a pause menu) from the next tick: `pausable` entities (the default) stop — behaviors, physics, animation, particles, sounds — while UI canvases and entities with process mode `always` or `when_paused` keep running. Sends `on pause` to every behavior. pause_game(false) = resume_game().
    resume_game() — Resumes a paused game from the next tick and sends `on resume`.
    teleport(entity: entity, position: vector|entity?) — Moves an entity instantly (when given a position) and tells render interpolation not to smear it across the screen: respawns, portals, checkpoints. Without a position it only resets the smoothing for this frame.
    time_scale(scale: number?) -> number — Slow motion / fast forward: time_scale(0.3) makes the game clock run at 30% from the next tick (dt, timers, waits, physics, animation, particles; 0..10). Entities on the `real` clock (UI, process clock real) ignore it. Returns the scale (the requested one).
    unscaled_dt() -> number — Real seconds per tick (1/60), whatever the time scale or pause: timers that must ignore slow motion.
    unscaled_time() -> number — Real seconds since play started (keeps counting while the game is paused or slowed; `time` does not).
  [vector]
    cross(a: vector, b: vector) -> vector — Cross product.
    direction(from: vector|entity, to: vector|entity) -> vector — Unit vector pointing from one point to another.
    distance(a: vector|entity, b: vector|entity) -> number — Distance between two points; entities count as their world position.
    dot(a: vector, b: vector) -> number — Dot product.
    forward(e: entity) -> vector — World direction the entity faces (its -Z axis).
    length(v: vector) -> number — Length (magnitude) of a vector.
    normalize(v: vector) -> vector — Vector scaled to length 1 (zero stays zero).
    right(e: entity) -> vector — World direction of the entity's right side (+X).
    up(e: entity) -> vector — World direction of the entity's up axis (+Y).
    vec(x: number, y: number, z: number) -> vector — Makes a vector (same as (x, y, z)).
    world_position(e: entity) -> vector — World position (self.position is relative to the parent).
  [vehicle]
    vehicle_drive(e: entity, throttle: number, steer: number, brake: number?, handbrake: number?) — Sets a vehicle's inputs for this tick: throttle 0..1, steer -1 (left)..1 (right), brake 0..1, handbrake 0..1. Overrides the player's drive actions this tick; with control "script" it is the only driver. Holding brake at a standstill reverses (autoReverse).
    vehicle_shift(e: entity, gear: number) — Manual gearbox: selects a gear (-1 reverse, 0 neutral, 1..). Automatic gearboxes shift by themselves.
    vehicle_speed(e: entity) -> number — Speed along the vehicle's heading in km/h (negative reversing).
    vehicle_state(e: entity) -> map — Live vehicle state: speed (km/h), rpm, gear, wheels_on_ground, skid 0..1, drift_angle (degrees), lateral_g, longitudinal_g, load 0..1 and skidding (a list of contact points of sliding wheels, for smoke and marks).
    vehicle_wheel(e: entity, wheel: number|string) -> none|map — One wheel's live state by index (0-based) or name ("rear_left"): contact, point, normal, surface, load (N), slip_ratio, slip_angle (degrees), skid 0..1, compression 0..1, steer, rpm, driven. none before play. Tire smoke and skid marks: spawn at `point` while `skid` > 0.3.
SUBSYSTEM TRIGGERS
    on action — An input action was pressed: on action "jump" (actions come from input.json).
    on collide — Two bodies touched: on collide ("name or tag")? — other, contact_point, contact_normal, impact.
    on dialogue — `on dialogue "start" | "line" | "choice" | "end" | "<command>"`: conversation events and <<command>>s of .dialogue scripts (event "dialogue:...").
    on pause — The game was paused (pause_game): delivered to every behavior, also those the pause stops.
    on resume — The game resumed (resume_game).
    on trigger_enter — Something entered this trigger collider: on trigger_enter ("name or tag")? — other.
    on trigger_exit — Something left this trigger collider: on trigger_exit ("name or tag")? — other.
    on ui — `on ui "Name"`: the button/toggle/slider/input named Name was used (event "ui:Name").
More: wander_reference topic="<category or function>" for details and examples.

dialogue.name: dialogue_choose
dialogue.doc: Picks one of the current dialogue choices (0-based).

dialogue.name: dialogue_var
dialogue.doc: Reads (or with a value, sets) a dialogue variable ($trust = "trust") of the first dialogue component.

dialogue.name: start_dialogue
dialogue.doc: Starts a conversation at a node: start_dialogue("Intro") on the first dialogue component, or start_dialogue(entity, "Intro").
`on dialogue "start" | "line" | "choice" | "end" | "<command>"`: conversation events and <<command>>s of .dialogue scripts (event "dialogue:...").

effects.name: burst
effects.doc: Emits particles right now from self's particles (or particles2d) component: burst(n), or burst(entity, n) for another emitter. Explosions, muzzle flashes, impacts, dust puffs.

effects.name: water_height
effects.doc: Height of the animated water surface at (x, z) or at a point — the same surface that is rendered (0 where there is no water). Boats, buoyancy, splashes.

input.name: action
input.doc: Whether an input action is held ("jump", "fire" from input.json).

input.name: axis
input.doc: Value of an axis action: a number (-1..1), or a vector (x, y, 0) for 2D axes (x right, y forward/up).

input.name: cursor_lock
input.doc: Hides and captures the mouse cursor (first-person look: read mouse movement with axis("look")) or gives it back. Honored by the standalone player; resets when the game stops.

input.name: key
input.example: if key("w") then move self by (0, 0, -speed * dt) end

input.name: key_pressed
input.doc: Whether a key was pressed this tick (once per press).

input.name: pressed
input.doc: Whether an input action was pressed this tick.

input.name: quit_game
input.doc: Closes the game (a "Quit" menu button). The standalone player exits; the editor ignores it.

input.name: released
input.doc: Whether an input action was released this tick.
An input action was pressed: on action "jump" (actions come from input.json).

list.name: contains
list.doc: Lists: has an equal item. Maps: has the key. Strings: has the substring. (Same as `x in y`.)

list.name: index_of
list.doc: Position of the first equal item/substring, or -1.

list.name: insert
list.doc: Inserts an item before index (index = length appends).

list.name: is_empty
list.doc: Whether it has no items / keys / characters.

list.name: join
list.doc: Text of all items joined by a separator.

list.name: pop
list.doc: Removes and returns the last item.

list.name: remove
list.doc: Lists: removes the first item equal to the argument. Maps: removes a key. Returns whether something was removed.

list.name: remove_at
list.doc: Removes and returns the item at index.

list.name: slice
list.doc: Items (or characters) from index `from` up to, not including, `to`. Negative indexes count from the end.

list.name: sort
list.doc: Sorts numbers or strings in place (ascending).

list.name: sum
list.doc: Sum of a list of numbers.

map.name: get
map.doc: Value for a key, or the default (none) if missing.

map.name: has
map.doc: Whether the map has a key.

map.name: set
map.doc: Sets a key (same as m[key] = value).

math.name: abs
math.doc: Absolute value.

math.name: acos
math.doc: Arc cosine in radians (x is clamped to -1..1).

math.name: approach
math.signature: approach(current: number, target: number, max_step: number) -> number
math.doc: Moves current toward target by at most max_step (never overshoots).

math.name: asin
math.doc: Arc sine in radians (x is clamped to -1..1).

math.name: atan
math.doc: Arc tangent in radians.

math.name: atan2
math.doc: Angle of the point (x, y) in radians, -pi..pi.

math.name: ceil
math.doc: Smallest whole number >= x.

math.name: clamp
math.signature: clamp(x: number, lo: number, hi: number) -> number
math.doc: x limited to the range lo..hi.

math.name: cos
math.doc: Cosine of an angle in radians.

math.name: deg
math.doc: Radians to degrees.

math.name: exp
math.doc: e raised to x.

math.name: floor
math.doc: Largest whole number <= x.

math.name: inverse_lerp
math.signature: inverse_lerp(a: number, b: number, x: number) -> number
math.doc: Where x lies between a (0) and b (1).

math.name: lerp
math.signature: lerp(a: number|vector|color, b: number|vector|color, t: number) -> number|vector|color
math.doc: Linear blend from a (t=0) to b (t=1); numbers, vectors or colors.

math.name: ln
math.doc: Natural logarithm (x > 0).

math.name: max
math.doc: Larger of numbers, or the largest number in a list.

math.name: min
math.doc: Smaller of numbers, or the smallest number in a list.

math.name: noise
math.doc: Smooth deterministic value noise in -1..1 (1D or 2D).

math.name: pow
math.doc: base raised to exponent.

math.name: rad
math.doc: Degrees to radians.

math.name: round
math.doc: Rounds to the nearest whole number, or to `digits` decimals.

math.name: sin
math.doc: Sine of an angle in radians.

math.name: smoothstep
math.signature: smoothstep(edge0: number, edge1: number, x: number) -> number
math.doc: Smooth 0..1 ramp between two edges.

math.name: sqrt
math.doc: Square root (0 for negative input).

math.name: tan
math.doc: Tangent of an angle in radians.

navigation.name: arrived
navigation.doc: Whether a nav agent reached its destination.

navigation.name: navigate
navigation.doc: Walks a nav agent to a point, or follows an entity as it moves. `on event "arrived"` fires on arrival.

navigation.name: path_length
navigation.doc: Walking distance along the navmesh; none if unreachable or there is no navmesh.

physics.name: impulse
physics.doc: An instant kick (N s) to a dynamic body.

physics.name: overlap_sphere
physics.signature: overlap_sphere(center: vector|entity, radius: number, tag: string?) -> none|entity
physics.doc: Nearest entity (not self) whose collider overlaps the sphere, optionally with a tag; none if empty.

physics.name: push
physics.doc: Applies a continuous force (N) to a dynamic body this step.

physics.name: raycast
physics.signature: raycast(origin: vector|entity, direction: vector, max_distance: number?) -> none|entity
physics.doc: First collider hit along a ray (self is ignored); sets hit_point, hit_normal and hit_distance.

physics.name: torque
physics.doc: Applies a torque (N m) to a dynamic body.

physics.name: velocity
physics.doc: Current linear velocity of a body or character (m/s).
Two bodies touched: on collide ("name or tag")? — other, contact_point, contact_normal, impact.
Something entered this trigger collider: on trigger_enter ("name or tag")? — other.
Something left this trigger collider: on trigger_exit ("name or tag")? — other.

random.name: pick
random.doc: A random element of a list (none if empty).

random.name: random
random.doc: random() is 0..1; random(hi) is 0..hi; random(lo, hi) is lo..hi. Seeded by the scene: replays exactly.

random.name: random_int
random.doc: A whole number from lo to hi (both included).

random.name: shuffle
random.doc: A shuffled copy of a list.

render.name: layer_mask
render.doc: Render layer bitmask from layer names (game.json render.layers), layer numbers as strings ("3"), "all" / "none", or a list of names / layer numbers; several arguments are combined. Set it on mesh.layers, camera.cullMask or light.cullMask, e.g. hide the player's own body from the first-person camera.

render.name: probe_bake
render.doc: Re-captures a reflection probe (or every probe without an argument) over the next rendered frames: after opening a door, switching the room's lights or rearranging furniture, so `once` probes reflect the new state. Rendering only; the simulation is unaffected.

scene.name: add_tag
scene.doc: Adds a tag to an entity.

scene.name: children
scene.doc: Direct children of an entity, in order.

scene.name: count
scene.doc: How many entities have a tag.

scene.name: exists
scene.doc: Whether a value is an entity that still exists.

scene.name: find
scene.doc: Entity by name (or "#id"); none if missing. "%Name" finds the entity marked unique (entity_update unique=true) inside this prefab instance, else in the scene, so each copy of a prefab finds its own part.

scene.name: find_all
scene.doc: Active entities with a tag, in scene order.

scene.name: has
scene.doc: Whether the entity has a component ("light", "particles", ...).

scene.name: nearest
scene.doc: Closest other active entity with a tag (within max_distance); none if there is none.

scene.name: remove_tag
scene.doc: Removes a tag from an entity.

scene.name: set_parent
scene.signature: set_parent(e: entity, parent: none|entity, keep_world: bool?)
scene.doc: Moves an entity under a new parent, or to the scene root with none. By default it keeps its world position, rotation and scale (keep_world = false keeps its local transform instead, so it jumps to the same offset from the new parent). Parenting under itself or a descendant fails. Like every play-time change, it is undone when play stops.
scene.example: set_parent(item, self)  -- pick it up; set_parent(item, none) drops it

scene.name: spawn
scene.signature: spawn(mesh: string, position: vector|entity?, name?) -> entity
scene.doc: Creates an entity: a primitive mesh ("cube", "sphere"...), "asset:models/x.glb", or a whole prefab "prefab:prefabs/coin.prefab.json" (with its children and behaviors). Its behaviors start next tick. Limits: 256 spawns per tick, 20000 entities.

scene.name: tagged
scene.doc: Whether an entity has a tag (false for none).

text.name: num
text.doc: Number parsed from text (none if it is not a number).

text.name: str
text.doc: Text form of any value (entities give their name).

text.name: type_of
text.doc: The type name: number, bool, string, vector, color, entity, list, map, none.

text.name: ends_with
text.doc: Whether the text ends with a suffix.

text.name: replace
text.doc: Copy with every occurrence of old replaced.

text.name: split
text.doc: Parts of the text between separators (default: spaces).

text.name: starts_with
text.doc: Whether the text starts with a prefix.

time.name: is_paused
time.doc: True while the game is paused (or will be from the next tick, after pause_game()).

time.name: pause_game
time.doc: Pauses the game (a pause menu) from the next tick: `pausable` entities (the default) stop — behaviors, physics, animation, particles, sounds — while UI canvases and entities with process mode `always` or `when_paused` keep running. Sends `on pause` to every behavior. pause_game(false) = resume_game().
time.example:
on action "pause"
  if is_paused() then resume_game() else pause_game() end
end

time.name: resume_game
time.doc: Resumes a paused game from the next tick and sends `on resume`.

time.name: teleport
time.doc: Moves an entity instantly (when given a position) and tells render interpolation not to smear it across the screen: respawns, portals, checkpoints. Without a position it only resets the smoothing for this frame.

time.name: time_scale
time.doc: Slow motion / fast forward: time_scale(0.3) makes the game clock run at 30% from the next tick (dt, timers, waits, physics, animation, particles; 0..10). Entities on the `real` clock (UI, process clock real) ignore it. Returns the scale (the requested one).
time.example:
time_scale(0.25)  -- bullet time
after 2 do time_scale(1) end

time.name: unscaled_dt
time.doc: Real seconds per tick (1/60), whatever the time scale or pause: timers that must ignore slow motion.

time.name: unscaled_time
time.doc: Real seconds since play started (keeps counting while the game is paused or slowed; `time` does not).
The game was paused (pause_game): delivered to every behavior, also those the pause stops.

vector.name: direction
vector.doc: Unit vector pointing from one point to another.
vector.example: move self by direction(self, goal) * speed * dt

vector.name: distance
vector.doc: Distance between two points; entities count as their world position.

vector.name: forward
vector.doc: World direction the entity faces (its -Z axis).
vector.example: move self by forward(self) * speed * dt

vector.name: normalize
vector.doc: Vector scaled to length 1 (zero stays zero).

vector.name: right
vector.doc: World direction of the entity's right side (+X).

vector.name: up
vector.doc: World direction of the entity's up axis (+Y).

vector.name: vec
vector.signature: vec(x: number, y: number, z: number) -> vector
vector.doc: Makes a vector (same as (x, y, z)).

vector.name: world_position
vector.doc: World position (self.position is relative to the parent).

vehicle.name: vehicle_drive
vehicle.signature: vehicle_drive(e: entity, throttle: number, steer: number, brake: number?, handbrake: number?)
vehicle.doc: Sets a vehicle's inputs for this tick: throttle 0..1, steer -1 (left)..1 (right), brake 0..1, handbrake 0..1. Overrides the player's drive actions this tick; with control "script" it is the only driver. Holding brake at a standstill reverses (autoReverse).

vehicle.name: vehicle_shift
vehicle.doc: Manual gearbox: selects a gear (-1 reverse, 0 neutral, 1..). Automatic gearboxes shift by themselves.
vehicle.example: if pressed("shift_up") then vehicle_shift(self, self.vehicle.gear + 1) end

vehicle.name: vehicle_speed
vehicle.doc: Speed along the vehicle's heading in km/h (negative reversing).

vehicle.name: vehicle_state
vehicle.doc: Live vehicle state: speed (km/h), rpm, gear, wheels_on_ground, skid 0..1, drift_angle (degrees), lateral_g, longitudinal_g, load 0..1 and skidding (a list of contact points of sliding wheels, for smoke and marks).

vehicle.name: vehicle_wheel
vehicle.doc: One wheel's live state by index (0-based) or name ("rear_left"): contact, point, normal, surface, load (N), slip_ratio, slip_angle (degrees), skid 0..1, compression 0..1, steer, rpm, driven. none before play. Tire smoke and skid marks: spawn at `point` while `skid` > 0.3.
